title: The model sees only what the user may see: authorisation around the model

videos.script: Tarefa's assistant answers questions about a client's own jobs. It searches Tarefa's records and puts what it finds in the prompt. {{title}} The search was never told whose search it was. Asked about a website, it returned another client's quote. {{search}} The tempting fix is a sentence in the prompt: use only this client's documents. {{rule}} The model was handed the answer and asked not to give it. Two of four answers gave it anyway. One was another client's price, and one was a staff note about fraud. {{leaks}} So the rule moves into the search. The filter runs before anything is ranked, and a document the client may not open never reaches the model. {{filter}} Then no answer leaks. And an audit with no model in it checks the filter: thirteen wrong results without it, none with it. {{audit}} The reader's identity comes from the session. It travels with every tool call, every cache and every log. {{identity}}
